bodyText: Hear from Sara LaBelle, culture programs manager at R1, on how Workhuman product innovation and integrations scale recognition and improve the employee experience. R1, the leading provider of technology-driven solutions that transform the patient experience and financial performance of healthcare providers, has been a Workhuman® customer since 2021. Its Social Recognition ®  program integrates with Workday and Microsoft Teams, and its 28,000+ employees across the U.S., India, and the Philippines have access to Inclusion Advisor, which helps identify and mitigate unconscious bias in real time. bodyText: Hear from Andrea LaBarbera, VP of global talent and engagement, on how she built the business case for recognition, what differentiated Workhuman from other vendors, and how Zimmer Biomet has used recognition and Yammer to build its culture. This interview was recorded at Workhuman® Live 2023 in San Diego. Watch it here.   Zimmer Biomet, a global medical technology leader, launched its Social Recognition® program in 2021. bodyText: Hear from Dave Bond, senior director of talent management, total rewards, and HR systems, on building recognition into the Minto Group community, why his team chose to partner with Workhuman ® , and how data from peer-to-peer recognition reaffirms that he’s achieving company goals. bodyText: Hear from Christopher Cardarelli, executive director of global diversity and inclusion at Merck, who discusses the business impact of providing employees with a strategic recognition tool they will actually adopt and use.
